headline: Sugarslime
title: Sugarslime | Sugary Downpour Regen | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Sugarslime is a stage three Ice Aniimo with one hundred fifteen regen. Its ultimate Sugary Downpour has power one hundred, hits an area and leaves a slowing field with Sweet Blobs. Evolve Sugarfish at level sixty two with a Freeze Stone. Homeland work is Ice, Leisure and Hauling, all level three. Beware Fire and Earth, which hit it harder. Is Sugarslime in your party? Comment below!
description: Aniimo Sugarslime guide: a stage 3 Ice Aniimo with 115 regen and the Sugary Downpour ultimate. Evolve Sugarfish at level 62 with a Freeze Stone. Weak to Fire and Earth. Checked on aniimo.gg and GameWith in November 2026.
joke: Sugarslime is so friendly that it shares its slime with everyone.
